mapper.sql: AND P.STOCK_ID = #{stockId} AND ( P.DEL_DAY IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_STOCK_COMMENT C WHERE 1=1 AND C.POST_ID = P.ID AND C.DEL_DAY IS NULL ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT P.ID AS POST_ID ,P.USER_ID ,U.NICKNAME ,CASE WHEN P.DEL_DAY IS NULL THEN P.OPINION END AS OPINION ,CASE WHEN P.DEL_DAY IS NULL THEN P.CONTENT END AS CONTENT ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM P.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS INS_AT ,(P.DEL_DAY IS NOT NULL) AS DELETED ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_COMMENT C WHERE 1=1 AND C.POST_ID = P.ID AND C.DEL_DAY IS NULL ) AS COMMENT_COUNT ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST_LIKE L WHERE 1=1 AND L.POST_ID = P.ID ) AS LIKE_COUNT ,EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_STOCK_POST_LIKE L WHERE 1=1 AND L.POST_ID = P.ID AND L.USER_ID = #{viewerId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ) AS LIKED ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST_REPORT R WHERE 1=1 AND R.POST_ID = P.ID AND R.STATUS = 'OPEN' ) AS REPORT_COUNT ,EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_STOCK_POST_REPORT R WHERE 1=1 AND R.POST_ID = P.ID AND R.USER_ID = #{viewerId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ) AS REPORTED FROM T_STOCK_POST P JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = P.USER_ID WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY LIKE_COUNT DESC, P.ID DESC
ORDER BY P.ID DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT P.ID AS POST_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME AS STOCK_NAME ,U.NICKNAME ,P.OPINION ,P.CONTENT ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM P.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS INS_AT ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_COMMENT C WHERE 1=1 AND C.POST_ID = P.ID AND C.DEL_DAY IS NULL ) AS COMMENT_COUNT ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST_LIKE L WHERE 1=1 AND L.POST_ID = P.ID ) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM T_STOCK_POST P JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = P.STOCK_ID JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = P.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND P.DEL_DAY IS NULL
AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST_REPORT R WHERE 1=1 AND R.POST_ID = P.ID AND R.STATUS = 'OPEN' ) < 3 ORDER BY P.ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST P WHERE 1=1

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE P.OPINION = 'UP') AS UP_COUNT ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE P.OPINION = 'DOWN') AS DOWN_COUNT FROM T_STOCK_POST P WHERE 1=1 AND P.STOCK_ID = #{stockId} AND P.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND P.INS_DAY >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT P.ID AS POST_ID ,P.STOCK_ID ,P.USER_ID FROM T_STOCK_POST P WHERE 1=1 AND P.ID = #{postId} AND P.DEL_DAY IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND INS_DAY >= NOW() - MAKE_INTERVAL(secs => #{seconds})

SELECT C.ID AS COMMENT_ID ,C.POST_ID ,C.USER_ID ,U.NICKNAME ,C.CONTENT ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM C.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS INS_AT FROM T_STOCK_COMMENT C JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = C.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND C.POST_ID = #{postId} AND C.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY C.ID LIMIT 200
SELECT C.ID AS COMMENT_ID ,C.POST_ID ,C.USER_ID FROM T_STOCK_COMMENT C WHERE 1=1 AND C.ID = #{commentId} AND C.DEL_DAY IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_COMMENT WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND INS_DAY >= NOW() - MAKE_INTERVAL(secs => #{seconds})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST_LIKE WHERE 1=1 AND POST_ID = #{postId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK_POST_REPORT WHERE 1=1 AND POST_ID = #{postId} AND STATUS = 'OPEN'

SELECT P.ID AS POST_ID ,P.STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME AS STOCK_NAME ,U.NICKNAME ,P.OPINION ,P.CONTENT ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM P.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS INS_AT ,(P.DEL_DAY IS NOT NULL) AS DELETED ,R.REPORT_COUNT ,R.REASONS ,R.MEMOS ,R.FIRST_REPORT_AT FROM ( SELECT X.POST_ID ,COUNT(*)::INT AS REPORT_COUNT ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MIN(X.INS_DAY)) * 1000)::BIGINT AS FIRST_REPORT_AT ,( SELECT STRING_AGG(Y.REASON || ':' || Y.CNT, ',' ORDER BY Y.CNT DESC) FROM ( SELECT Z.REASON ,COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM T_STOCK_POST_REPORT Z WHERE 1=1 AND Z.POST_ID = X.POST_ID AND Z.STATUS = 'OPEN' GROUP BY Z.REASON ) Y ) AS REASONS ,STRING_AGG(NULLIF(TRIM(X.MEMO), ''), ' / ') AS MEMOS FROM T_STOCK_POST_REPORT X WHERE 1=1 AND X.STATUS = 'OPEN' GROUP BY X.POST_ID ) R JOIN T_STOCK_POST P ON P.ID = R.POST_ID JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = P.STOCK_ID JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = P.USER_ID ORDER BY R.REPORT_COUNT DESC, R.FIRST_REPORT_AT LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT POST_ID) FROM T_STOCK_POST_REPORT WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'OPEN'
SELECT P.ID AS POST_ID ,P.STOCK_ID ,P.USER_ID ,(P.DEL_DAY IS NOT NULL) AS DELETED FROM T_STOCK_POST P WHERE 1=1 AND P.ID = #{postId}
